text: Take orders on a register, an iPad or a phone, and add to a check that has already gone to the kitchen.
Send orders to the kitchen screen and to the kitchen and receipt printers. The kitchen sees only what is new.
Floor plans by room, with the tables where they really are.
Sold-out items marked right on the menu, with the count left (“3 left”) and a “Running Low” flag.
A time clock with corrections and paid and unpaid breaks, side work lists, and a shift log for handover notes.
Close the day with a check of open checks and the cash you should have.
Reports that add up to what each bill actually charged.
Roles that say who may do what, with every change on the record.
A lighter mode for older devices.
Your records are kept on your own machine. Cloud services, usage reports and Google Drive backups stay off unless you turn them on.
